@global/accesskey.reason: Kept as a single key (as in the legacy document) for API ergonomics; the spec allows a space-separated list of single code points.

@global/aria.reason: aria-* attributes (ARIA in HTML) are not in browser-compat-data's HTML globals; modelled as a prefix like data-*.

@global/autocapitalize.reason: Enumerated attribute; IDL only has a DOMString setter.

@global/autocorrect.reason: Enumerated attribute (empty string = on); IDL exposes a boolean.

@global/class.reason: Set of space-separated tokens; DOM's Element.className is not reflected with a DOMTokenList type in IDL.

@global/contenteditable.reason: Enumerated attribute; IDL exposes a DOMString with custom getter.

@global/draggable.reason: Enumerated true/false attribute, not a boolean attribute, although the IDL type is boolean.

@global/hidden.reason: Enumerated attribute; the bare attribute means hidden. IDL type is a union.

@global/itemid.reason: Microdata globals are not listed by browser-compat-data; valid URL potentially surrounded by spaces.

@global/itemprop.reason: Microdata; unordered set of unique space-separated tokens.

@global/itemref.reason: Microdata; unordered set of unique space-separated tokens (IDs).

@global/itemtype.reason: Microdata; unordered set of unique space-separated tokens (absolute URLs).

@global/part.reason: CSS Shadow Parts: space-separated part names.

@global/popover.reason: Enumerated attribute (bare = auto). The legacy document typed it as String.
